description: This Java class implements a command handler for creating account number formats within the larger Fineract project. It processes 'CREATE' commands for the ACCOUNTNUMBERFORMAT entity, delegating the creation logic to the AccountNumberFormatWritePlatformService.

classes.name: CreateAccountNumberFormatCommandHandler
classes.description: A service class that handles commands for creating new account number formats in the system.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the create command by delegating to the account number format write platform service.
